top: In 2020 a 90-year-old man left a small French village about €2 million in his will. At first, nobody knew why.
comment: During World War II, Le Chambon-sur-Lignon hid his Jewish family from the Nazis. He asked that the money go to scholarships for the village's young people.
topic_it: Erich Schwam, ebreo austriaco morto a 90 anni nel dicembre 2020, lascia circa 2 milioni di euro a Le Chambon-sur-Lignon, il villaggio che nascose la sua famiglia durante la guerra; soldi per borse di studio
photo_it: Esposizione storica con stella gialla 'Juif' (Getty, via CBS News)
sound: it's like i'm not even here — mthu
title: He never forgot the village that saved his family from the Nazis #history #hero #ww2
description:
Erich Schwam left about €2 million to Le Chambon-sur-Lignon, the French village that hid his Jewish family during World War II, for scholarships for its young people.
